result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a couple of visible content and layout concerns in the restaurant carousels and fixed bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel shows Green Bowl Poké twice with identical imagery, name, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Verify the carousel data and replace the duplicate card with a distinct restaurant or remove the duplicate entry.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, leaving its content partially hidden behind the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category row and restaurant carousel are clipped at the right edge, showing partial chips/cards without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling is intentional and consider adding a subtle fade, peek indicator, or other cue that more items are available.
